selection.ownership: Bolna (YC F25). PitchBook lists a Dover, DE corporate office; LinkedIn lists San Francisco HQ and Bengaluru. International REST API at api.bolna.ai; not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Bolna API (Authorization Bearer, GET /user/me, GET /v2/agent/all, GET /v2/agent/{agent_id}, GET /v2/agent/{agent_id}/executions, GET /executions/{execution_id}), dashboard Developers API keys, company identity (YC F25, US/India), and dated incident search (Bolna AI + security breach/incident). Dutch retailer bol.com CEVA logistics incident is a different company. No qualifying current unresolved Bolna customer-data compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Bolna API authenticates with Authorization Bearer against https://api.bolna.ai. GET /user/me is the pinned credential validator and a cheap authenticated read. Agent list/get and execution list/get are documented reads. Operator is Bolna (YC F25) with US incorporation/HQ listings and Bengaluru operations. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Bolna platform compromise; bol.com logistics reporting is a different company.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Declarative POST /v2/agent/{agent_id}/copy. Official public docs list import in the dashboard; request still targets api.bolna.ai.
Declarative POST /v2/agent with agent_config and agent_prompts.
Declarative POST /v2/agent/from-template for Composio BOLNA_CREATE_TEMPLATE_AGENT.
Declarative DELETE /v2/agent/{agent_id}.
agent_id is a required path segment on GET /v2/agent/{agent_id}.
Declarative GET /agent/{agent_uuid} (deprecated v1).
Declarative POST /v2/agent/import with agent_id in the JSON body.
Official GET /v2/agent/all returns a JSON array. Native returns that raw array under data rather than the upstream {agents} wrapper.
Declarative GET /agent/all (v1 list) with optional pagination query. v2 GET /v2/agent/all stays agents.list.
Declarative PATCH /agent/{agent_uuid} (deprecated v1).
Declarative POST /v2/agent/{agent_id}/stop.
Declarative PUT /v2/agent/{agent_id} (full replace). MCP patch maps to a different verb; Composio documents PUT.
Handwritten multipart POST /batches (CSV file + agent_id).
Declarative DELETE /batches/{batch_id}.
Declarative GET /v2/batches/{batch_id}/executions. page_size max 50 matches Composio.
Declarative GET /batches/{batch_id}.
Declarative GET /batches/{agent_id}/all.
Form-urlencoded POST /batches/{batch_id}/schedule (official also accepts multipart scheduled_at).
Declarative POST /batches/{batch_id}/stop.
Declarative POST /call with agent_id and recipient_phone_number.
Declarative GET /agent/{agent_id}/execution/{execution_id}.
execution_id is a required path segment on GET /executions/{execution_id}.

Maps to GET /v2/agent/{agent_id}/executions with optional page_number (1-9999) and page_size (1-50). status/call_type/provider filters and the paired from/to date range are omitted (from and to must be sent together per official docs).
Origin GET /v2/agent/{agent_id}/executions kept; added Composio optional filters. from/to remain optional so origin fixtures still pass.
Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /user/me, matching the pinned validator.
Native category is messaging (voice calling). Source AI/Communication are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist. Returns raw Bolna JSON under data rather than the upstream {user} wrapper.
Declarative POST /inbound/setup.
Handwritten multipart POST /knowledgebase (url and/or PDF).
Declarative DELETE /knowledgebase/{rag_id}.
Declarative GET /knowledgebase/{rag_id}.
Declarative GET /knowledgebase/all with optional status filter.
Declarative GET /phone-numbers/all.
Declarative GET /phone-numbers/search?country= (OpenAPI marks country as path; live query matches the search docs).
Declarative POST /providers with official provider_name and provider_value JSON.
Declarative GET /providers.
Declarative DELETE /providers/{provider_key_name}.
Declarative GET /user/me. Same path as healthcheck; extra Composio user_id/is_api_request are optional query params.
Declarative GET /api/v1/voice-config/tts/voices. Official requires provider_id and model_id; Composio omits them.
